phase0.input: Drop one steel plate onto the upward-facing saw.

phase0.note: An isolated8SUsaw station manufactures the first steel shafts and remains separate from the main8SUrubber drive. Current cog recipes do not require plates. No saw disassembly, inherited finished shaft, wrench or raised capacity is credited.

phase3.note: Remove the compressor input shaft without crediting recovery. Use the sixth paid shaft on the gearbox east side to power the separate press; the compressor and sapper remain intact and disconnected. Collect/move the same depot before pressing.

drive.scope: Physical apparatus counts and native constructive phase plan only. Material procurement and actual placement, flow, gear/network formation and operation remain qualification.
drive.manualChangeover: Exact axes/facings are placement conditions. Swap the sapper-driving small cog for the Y-axis gearbox, leaving sapper/tank intact; do not credit recovery of that cog. Later remove the compressor input shaft, then place the separately paid sixth shaft and press east of the gearbox. A wrench or recovery drop is not credited. The direct saw station stays isolated.
